THE CLAUSE

Like any system that interacts with hundreds of millions of users, AI systems also carry potential risks for harm. Parts of the Model Spec consist of rules aimed at minimizing these risks. Not all risks from AI can be mitigated through model behavior alone; the Model Spec is just one component of our overall safety strategy.

THE CLAIMS READ OUT OF IT

  C1 AI systems carry potential risks for harm
  C2 parts of the Model Spec consist of rules aimed at minimizing these risks
  C3 not all risks from AI can be mitigated through model behavior alone
  C4 the Model Spec is just one component of OpenAI's overall safety strategy

EVERY SENTENCE THE TRANSLATION RENDERS BACK

  0. «S is an AI system of the kind that interacts with large numbers of users»
  1. «S carries potential risks for harm to users or others»
  2. «R is a rule that is part of the Model Spec»
  3. «R is a rule whose purpose is to minimize the potential risks for harm that AI systems carry»
  4. «the risk is one that can be mitigated through model behavior alone»
  5. «R is a potential risk for harm arising from AI systems»
  6. «C is a component of OpenAI's overall safety strategy»
  7. «OpenAI's overall safety strategy, of which the Model Spec is one component»
  8. S is «S is an AI system and carries potential risks for harm» when «S is an AI system of the kind that interacts with large numbers of users»
  9. R is «R is a Model Spec rule aimed at minimizing the potential risks for harm that AI systems carry» when «R is a rule that is part of the Model Spec»
  10. «the Model Spec document that the assistant must adhere to above all else» is «the Model Spec is one component of OpenAI's overall safety strategy»
